Departmental Information Security Incident Response Team (ISIRT) Commander", "text_level": 2, "bbox": [ 114, 532, 843, 569 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "The ISIRT is the central focal point for co-ordinating the handling of information security incidents occurring within the respective B/D. The Head of B/D should designate an officer from the senior management to be the ISIRT Commander. The ISIRT Commander should have the authority to appoint core team members for the ISIRT. The responsibilities of an ISIRT Commander include:", "bbox": [ 184, 593, 872, 677 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Provide overall supervision and co-ordination of information security incident handling for all information systems within the B/D;", "bbox": [ 186, 693, 857, 726 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Make decisions on critical matters such as damage containment, system recovery, the engagement of external parties and the extent of involvement, and service resumption logistics after recovery;", "bbox": [ 186, 728, 868, 776 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Trigger the departmental disaster recovery procedure where appropriate, depending on the impact of the incident on the business operation of the B/D;", "bbox": [ 188, 777, 850, 810 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Provide management endorsement on the provision of resources for the incident handling process;", "bbox": [ 186, 812, 870, 844 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Provide management endorsement in respect of the line-to-take for publicity on the incident;", "bbox": [ 186, 845, 867, 877 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Collaborate with GIRO in reporting information security incidents for central", "bbox": [ 186, 878, 850, 896 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "header", "text": "BASELINE IT SECURITY POLICY", "bbox": [ 117, 49, 389, 64 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "header", "text": "GOVERNMENT ORGANISATION STRUCTURE", "bbox": [ 504, 49, 880, 64 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "footer", "text": "Ref. No. : S17", "bbox": [ 117, 912, 220, 926 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "page_number", "text": "14", "bbox": [ 860, 912, 880, 925 ], "page_idx": 19 }, { "type": "text", "text": "recording and necessary follow-up actions; and", "bbox": [ 215, 93, 608, 110 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Facilitate experience and information sharing within the B/D on information security incident handling and related matters.", "bbox": [ 186, 111, 842, 146 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "5.2.5 IT Security Management Unit", "text_level": 2, "bbox": [ 115, 161, 468, 180 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "B/Ds shall establish an IT security management unit which reports to DITSO and assists DITSO in discharging his/her duties. The size and composition of the unit may vary among B/Ds depending on the business and operational needs of B/Ds. The responsibilities of the IT security management unit include:", "bbox": [ 184, 199, 853, 267 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Assist DITSO in overseeing the security governance process for the IT security related activities within the B/D;", "bbox": [ 186, 290, 865, 323 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Assist DITSO in the IT security management process for all IT operations of the B/D;", "bbox": [ 186, 324, 873, 355 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Assist DITSO in developing, establishing, and maintaining the overall IT security strategy and roadmap for the B/D, including formulating IT security policies, baselines, standards, directives, etc.;", "bbox": [ 186, 357, 843, 407 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Co-ordinate security awareness and training programmes within the B/D;", "bbox": [ 186, 409, 816, 424 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Co-ordinate the implementation of IT security initiatives and monitor the status of IT security processes to ensure the effectiveness of IT security management and compliance with government security requirements;", "bbox": [ 186, 425, 865, 475 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Facilitate IT security threat and risk management activities and support disaster recovery and business continuity planning functions relating to IT security;", "bbox": [ 186, 476, 865, 508 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Co-ordinate security incident investigation and rectification;", "bbox": [ 186, 510, 714, 526 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Liaise with other B/Ds and parties on IT security matters; and", "bbox": [ 186, 527, 724, 543 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "• Perform any other duties as directed by the DITSO.", "bbox": [ 186, 544, 640, 561 ], "page_idx": 20 }, { "type": "text", "text": "5.3. These principles are fundamental in nature and rarely change. B/Ds shall observe these principles for developing, implementing and understanding security policies. The principles listed below are by no means exhaustive.", "bbox": [ 184, 129, 870, 214 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": " Information System Security Objectives", "text_level": 2, "bbox": [ 188, 230, 576, 246 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Information system security objectives or goals are described in terms of three overall objectives: Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability. Security policies and measures shall be developed and implemented according to these objectives.", "bbox": [ 213, 247, 872, 312 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": " Risk Based Approach", "text_level": 2, "bbox": [ 188, 330, 418, 346 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": "A risk based approach shall be adopted to identify, prioritise and address the security risks of information systems in a consistent and effective manner. Proper security measures shall be implemented according to the classified protection of IT security described in Section 7.2 to protect information assets and systems and mitigate security risks to an acceptable level.", "bbox": [ 216, 347, 860, 430 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": " Security by Design Approach", "text_level": 2, "bbox": [ 189, 445, 484, 462 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Security by design shall be adopted to incorporate security requirements into the system development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring that information systems and applications are implemented with appropriate security and data protection measures. Preventive measures avoid or deter the occurrence of an undesirable event. Detective measures identify the occurrence of an undesirable event. Response measures refer to co-ordinated actions to contain damage when an undesirable event (or incident) occurs. Recovery measures restore the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information systems to their expected state.", "bbox": [ 211, 585, 882, 701 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "text", "text": "Protection of information while being processed, in transit, and in storage Security measures shall be considered and implemented as appropriate to preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information while it is being processed, in transit, and in storage. As an example, wireless communication without protection is vulnerable to attacks, and security measures shall be adopted when transmitting classified information.", "bbox": [ 186, 718, 872, 818 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "header", "text": "BASELINE IT SECURITY POLICY", "bbox": [ 115, 49, 389, 64 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "header", "text": "CORE SECURITY PRINCIPLES", "bbox": [ 630, 49, 880, 64 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "page_number", "text": "18", "bbox": [ 860, 912, 880, 925 ], "page_idx": 23 }, { "type": "footer", "text": "Ref.
